---
title: "compareinstances"
sidebarTitle: "compareinstances"
description: "Compares the Instance references stored in two Instance object values."
keywords: ["compareinstances","Cache"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
compareinstances(first: Instance, second: Instance): boolean
```

## Arguments

<ParamField path={"first"} type={"Instance"} required>
First Instance object to compare.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path={"second"} type={"Instance"} required>
Second Instance object to compare.
</ParamField>

## Returns

<ResponseField name={"equal"} type={"boolean"}>
True when both Instance object values contain the same underlying reference.
</ResponseField>

## Example

Compare the underlying Instance references.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

print(compareinstances(Players, Players))
print(compareinstances(Players, ReplicatedStorage))
```


</div>
